desc: Windows with bottom-up or high-entropy ASLR off (Exploit Protection), as TTYD_LOW_ADDRESSES makes it: the program's memory under 4 GiB, most of it under 2 GiB. The game starts (it once stopped at its start-up check), boots to Rogueport's plaza, walks and plays its sounds (sound names in memory under 2 GiB are told from ids by their text)
log_must: ^\[memory\] TTYD_LOW_ADDRESSES: started with bottom-up and high-entropy ASLR off
the C heap at \S+ is under 2 GiB
